environmentVariables.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM

environmentVariables.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.
environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS

server.description: D2L Brightspace MCP server: grades, due dates, assignments, announcements and files. Any school.
server.name: io.github.RohanMuppa/brightspace

environmentVariables.description: Your school's Brightspace URL. Default: https://purdue.brightspace.com. Normally set by the setup wizard in ~/.brightspace-mcp/config.json instead.
environmentVariables.name: D2L_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Local root for separate per-school/account directories containing encrypted tokens and browser storage. Encryption keys are kept in the native credential store. Default: ~/.d2l-session
environmentVariables.name: D2L_SESSION_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Run browser authentication without a visible window. Set false only for MFA methods that require browser interaction. Default: true
environmentVariables.name: D2L_HEADLESS

environmentVariables.description: Seconds an access token is used before it is re-minted from the session cookie. Default: 3600
environmentVariables.name: D2L_TOKEN_TTL

environmentVariables.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to include. Default: all enrolled courses.
environmentVariables.name: D2L_INCLUDE_COURSES

environmentVariables.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to exclude.
environmentVariables.name: D2L_EXCLUDE_COURSES

environmentVariables.description: Only return courses whose enrollment is active. Default: true
environmentVariables.name: D2L_ACTIVE_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Only return courses whose Access.StartDate to Access.EndDate window contains now, matching Brightspace's "Current Courses" widget. Default: false
environmentVariables.name: D2L_CURRENT_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to record local tool timestamps and safe authentication outcomes in the account session directory. No arguments, results or credentials are logged. Default: false.
environmentVariables.name: D2L_DEV_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Set to any value to disable the startup check against the npm registry for a newer version.
environmentVariables.name: D2L_NO_UPDATE_CHECK

environmentVariables.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

environmentVariables.description: Allow list of days message content may be read, e.g. "mon,thu" (weekdays, YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD, in DISPLAY_TZ). Other days: subjects only, nothing marked read. Unset = every day.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_READ_DAYS

environmentVariables.description: Deny list of days message content may NOT be read (same format as OFW_READ_DAYS; wins over it). Unset = none.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_NO_READ_DAYS

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE

environmentVariables.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE

environmentVariables.name: OFW_EXPENSE_UPLOAD_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set "true" to return attachments as MCP content blocks by default (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Callers can still override per call via the tool's `inline` argument.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_INLINE_ATTACHMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Where ofw_download_attachment writes (default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp). Every disk write is confined to it: a saveTo outside it (after resolving symlinks) is refused, and an existing file is replaced only with force:true.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR

environmentVariables.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may read from (default: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR). Paths outside it after resolving symlinks, hidden files/dirs, and files over 25 MiB are refused.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_UPLOAD_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_CACHE_IDENTITY

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the message cache directory (default ~/.cache/ofw-mcp).
environmentVariables.name: OFW_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).
environmentVariables.name: OFW_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY

environmentVariables.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_AUTO_REFRESH

environmentVariables.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS

environmentVariables.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).
environmentVariables.name: OFW_SYNC_MAX_REQUESTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.
environmentVariables.name: OFW_DEBUG_LOG

environmentVariables.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. server.description: Q402 - gasless payments, yield, escrow, bridge & NAV triggers on 12 EVM chains. Sandbox-default.
server.name: io.github.quackai-org/q402-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).
environmentVariables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_WALLET_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE
